items.prompt: It ___ noted that small exclusions, aggregated, shape who feels they belong.
items.hintAfterError: É passiva no present perfect: 'has' + particípio de 'be' + 'noted'.

items.prompt: It was ___ that the CEO chair the inclusion council personally.
It is ___ that diversity is a strategic asset, but influence tells a different story.
items.hintAfterError: Estrutura passiva: 'It is' + particípio. O verbo 'say' é irregular.

items.prompt: It has been ___ that London-based staff still dominate the key decisions.
It ___ recommended that the board review promotion data every year.
items.hintAfterError: 'It' é singular e a estrutura é passiva: verbo 'to be' no passado + particípio.
